text:
Jess: quick design review request / embedding preview page. Customer asked if we can toggle 'dense' vs 'compact' row styles for large batches — dense shows vectors in-line, compact collapses vector rows to a single summary. Thoughts?
Amar: Large batches need better perf. Compact mode should lazy-render vectors on expand. Also add a small per-row 'peek' that shows top-3 dims (max values).
Lee: Agree. UX idea: default to compact for >200 rows. Add a sticky density toggle in the table toolbar so users can switch.
Noor: For rerank workflows, people often want to compare original rank vs reranked position. Can we add a tiny delta badge e.g., ▲-3 or ▼+2 next to the rank?
Priya: Delta badges are fine but color choices must be careful for a11y. Use icons plus text and ensure color contrast. Also the badge needs aria-label like "moved up 3 positions".
a11y-bot: Recommendation: use non-color indicators (triangle up/down) plus text. Ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text. Add aria-live for dynamic rerank changes if the table updates in place.
Jess: Exporting question: should CSV include full embedding vector as comma-separated list? Customers want both compact representation (e.g., vector_norm + top_dims) and full vector file (maybe parquet) for downstream analytics.
Amar: Parquet would be ideal for large exports but heavier to implement. Short-term: include two exports: 'CSV (summary)' and 'JSONL (full vectors)'. JSONL for large vectors is common.
Lee: Where to surface those? In the export modal, make formats explicit and show estimated size for the current selection (approx). E.g., "CSV (summary) ~ 120KB", "JSONL (full) ~ 4.6MB".
Noor: Good call. We can compute estimate from sample: size ~ rows * (dims * bytes_per_dim). Rough calc on backend.
Priya: Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+E to open export modal. Must be documented and not conflict with browser. Also ensure shortcut is discoverable in UI via tooltip.
Jess: UX microcopy for modal: header "Export vectors"; option labels: "CSV (summary) - id, text_snippet, vector_norm, top_dims" and "JSONL (full) - includes full vector array". Add small line "Truncated snippets: first 300 chars" when enabled.
Amar: Implement a 'mask_text' toggle so teams can hide PII before export. Default: false but require explicit enable for datasets marked sensitive.
Lee: Implementation note: table virtualization + accordion for vector details. Frontend: use intersection observer to fetch/render vector preview when expanded. Backend: support endpoints paged by batch_id + offset.
Noor: Also discuss copy-to-clipboard behavior: customers expect a single click icon to copy the current visible table (summary) as CSV. If table uses virtualization, only visible rows will be copied. We should copy the full selected set, not just visible rows.
Priya: Important for screen reader and keyboard users: copy action should announce number of rows copied, e.g., "Copied 1,248 rows to clipboard". Use aria-live polite.
a11y-bot: Ensure the copy button has aria-describedby pointing to the confirmation live region. Avoid silent toasts only.
Jess: Mobile: space is tight. Convert density toggle into menu within kebab. Export modal should be full screen on small devices.
Amar: Add a small inline label in the header when rerank is enabled: "Reranked view" with a question mark tooltip explaining differences.
Lee: Sorting behavior: when in rerank mode, default sort should be by relevance_score desc, but allow switching. Persist sort preference per-user.
Noor: For 'compare' mode (select two rows to diff), show side-by-side small vector heatmap and highlight top-10 matching dims. Could be a future enhancement.
Priya: I'll draft an a11y checklist: keyboard nav, focus trap in modal, ARIA labels for density toggle, announce export size, live region for copy, color contrast checks.
Jess: Action items: Lee -> density toggle + virtualization changes; Noor -> export size estimate API + mask_text flag; Sam is OOO but Amar will prototype modal copy behaviors; Priya -> a11y checklist and copy messages; Jess -> write microcopy and mock screens.
Amar: I'll make a quick prototype and post Loom of interactions.
Jess: Thanks team. Will open a design PR with mock and attach prototype.
